limits: Lint checks authoring structure and selected BDD rules; it does not establish business correctness.
Review fields are recorded claims. Lint does not authenticate reviewers or grant approval.
Source references are not fetched or authenticated. Lint does not prove provenance or runtime relationships.
Markdown checks cover selected structures; lint is not a complete CommonMark parser.
Gherkin checks cover an English subset. No business step definitions execute.
Lint does not establish complete ASD-STE100 compliance or passing business execution.

details.limit: Selected prose line length only. Not a full ASD dictionary or grammar review.

limitations: Automated checks do not check the complete approved dictionary or grammar rules.

material_limits: No browser run, live API request, full application suite, or release assessment.
Artifact lint retains unknown-owner, pending-review, unresolved-content, and writing-review warnings.
Unrelated concurrent workspace changes remain outside this stage.
